title: Northwind Robotics closes €45m round to fund Asia push
text:
Dutch warehouse automation start-up Northwind Robotics has closed a €45 million funding round, two people familiar with the deal told EuroTech Wire.

The round was led by Halden Ventures. The company plans to use part of the money to enter Asian markets, starting with India, one of the people said.

Northwind Robotics declined to comment on the size of the round. In a statement the company said only that it had "completed a Series B financing" and would give details of its expansion plans later this year.
